_comment: claude_desktop_config.json. Pick ONE of the two entries below and delete the other — both are shown because which one works depends on your Claude Desktop version. Verify against Apify's current MCP docs; this format has changed before. Restart Claude Desktop after editing.
_option_1_oauth: Remote URL, Claude handles sign-in. Nothing secret on disk. Try this first.
_option_2_bridge: Local stdio bridge that adds the Authorization header, for versions that cannot send custom headers to a remote server.
